description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform architect. Discuss tenant isolation, modular monolith decomposition, FinOps, tenant tiering. Invocable for ad-hoc consultations; also canonical home for shared platform-module resources (fragments, patterns, standards, checklists).

Verify the BAM v6 universal-glob activation mechanism end-to-end. Resolver-side checks: literal universal-glob string survives BMAD's three-layer customize merge into target skill's persistent_facts; sentinel file present at {output_folder}/bbp/project-context.md. Run after bmad install or BMAD-version change.

Generate (or refresh) the universal-glob sentinel at {output_folder}/bbp/project-context.md so BMAD core skills auto-load BAM v6 platform context at activation. Run once after bmad install bmad-bam-platform.

Facilitated design workflow: choose multi-tenant isolation model (RLS / schema-per-tenant / cell-based / hybrid) based on tenant projections, compliance scope, blast-radius tolerance. Output: tenancy-model.md design doc + ADR + QG-M2 partial evidence.

Bounded contexts + ports/adapters decomposition. Default: hybrid DDD + hexagonal. Decision matrix scores ddd-pure / ports-pure / hybrid / vertical-slice. Output: module-decomposition.md + .json (QG-F1 + QG-M1 evidence). Invoke via `/bmad-bam-design-modular-monolith`.

Tenant cohorts + rollout strategy (blue-green / canary). Tightly coupled to tenancy choice. 4 tier-mapped defaults baked in. Output: deployment-topology.md + .json (QG-F1 evidence). REQUIRES tenancy-decision.json. Invoke via `/bmad-bam-design-deployment-topology`.

Unit economics + per-tenant cost attribution. Reads tenancy + tier + deployment artifacts (all required). Last in dep order; runs verify-coherence. Output: finops-baseline.md + .json + foundation-coherence.json (QG-F1 evidence). Invoke via `/bmad-bam-design-finops-model`.

5 default tiers (free/starter/pro/business/enterprise); --custom-tiers N for 3-7-tier projects. Includes downstream-contract hints (rollout_tier_hint, cost_ceiling_usd_per_month_hint, upgrade_mode). Output: tier-model.md + .json (QG-F1 evidence). Invoke via `/bmad-bam-design-tenant-tier-model`.
